name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage conversion varies widely based on several factors, including the size of the garage, the intended use of the new space (e.g., basic room vs. full kitchen/bathroom), the extent of structural changes, and the quality of finishes chosen. Costs can range significantly from a simpler conversion to a complex ADU with plumbing and electrical upgrades. A detailed estimate requires an on-site evaluation to assess your specific project needs and desired features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversion costs vary based on size, intended use, structural changes, and finishes. A basic conversion differs from a full ADU, and a custom estimate is needed.
